verdict.rationale: Gecko is a SaaS security scanner (not itself an agent), so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis; docs explicitly describe an AI-tools/MCP integration letting a connected AI agent list repos/scans, pull vulnerability evidence, triage findings, and file tickets, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server itself works reliably (community evidence only covers scan accuracy issues, not the MCP integration specifically) and details on setup/auth for the MCP connection.
